mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id, r.tenant_id, r.role_code, r.role_nm, r.role_dc, r.use_at, r.is_system_role, COALESCE(rc.user_count, 0) AS user_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM tb_role r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM tb_login_account_role GROUP BY role_id ) rc ON rc.role_id = r.role_id WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
INSERT INTO tb_role ( tenant_id, role_code, role_nm, role_dc, is_system_role, use_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleNm}, #{roleDc}, 'N', #{useAt} ) RETURNING role_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, role_dc = #{roleDc}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_nm AS userNm, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '-') AS departmentNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, NULL AS lastLoginAt FROM tb_login_account_role lar JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = lar.login_id JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE lar.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_nm AS userNm, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '-') AS departmentNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, NULL AS lastLoginAt FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(la.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_login_account_role lar WHERE lar.login_id = u.login_id AND lar.role_id = #{roleId} ) ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC

SELECT lar.login_account_role_id FROM tb_login_account_role lar JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lar.role_id WHERE lar.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ( (#{loginId} IS NOT NULL AND lar.login_id = CAST(#{loginId} AS BIGINT)) OR (#{userId} IS NOT NULL AND lar.login_id = ( SELECT u.login_id FROM tb_user u WHERE u.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS BIGINT) AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1 )) ) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_account_role (login_id, role_id) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{roleId}) ON CONFLICT (login_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId, u.user_nm AS userNm, COALESCE(d.department_nm, '-') AS departmentNm, u.email_addr AS emailAddr, NULL AS lastLoginAt FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
